title: The finite-stage boundary input is a consequence
statement:
The boundary duality input of [def-weil-boundary-duality-input]
holds for every separated finite-type $Y/k$ and every finite stage
$A=A_{E,n}$. In particular the canonical evaluation-defined map

$$
\beta_L:i^*D_TL\longrightarrow D_ZRi^!L
$$

is an isomorphism for every closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow T$
between the locally closed pieces in that definition.

proof.text: Obtain the canonical operations o and their normalized geometric model from [lem-weil-boundary-normalized-models]. Its hypotheses are exactly the separated finite-type datum and the positive coefficient level n+1 of the conclusion.

Prove closure of the actual finite-Tor constructible predicate under isomorphisms by transporting constructibility and representatives of Tor intervals. Prove opposite currying directly from tau naturality at (id,delta_L), evaluation of delta_L and symmetry cancellation. Unfold the specified transposes. The normalized evaluation equation identifies o.delta with native toIhomIhom; normalized symmetry and evaluation identify o.exchange with the literal beta of [lem-weil-boundary-bidual-transpose], and identify that lemma's alpha with the transpose required by Assertions.alpha_normalization. Apply its third clause using alpha at D_TL, delta_L and delta_sD_TL to prove exchange_isIso. Apply its second clause and the same explicit identifications to prove compatibility. Retain theta and tau and their normalization equations from the model, and package these fields into Assertions and then Data of [def-weil-boundary-duality-input].
